literal: Smile, giving, sweet words, not despising, all four, attributes they say, to a true family.
translation: A cheerful smile, generosity, sweet words, and not despising others—these four, they say, are the attributes of a true noble family.
modern: முகமலர்ச்சி, ஈகை, இனிய சொல், மற்றவரை இகழாதிருத்தல் ஆகிய நான்கும் உண்மையான நற்குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களின் இயல்புகள் என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet lists four essential qualities that characterize people born in a truly noble family. 'நகை' (smile) represents a cheerful and welcoming disposition. 'ஈகை' (giving) and 'இன்சொல்' (sweet words) show their generosity and kindness towards others. 'இகழாமை' (not despising) highlights their humility and respect for everyone. Together, these four traits are said to be the defining attributes ('வகை') of a genuine lineage ('வாய்மைக் குடி').
